constraints.name: graph_is_tree
constraints.description: The maze consists of n rooms and n-1 bidirectional corridors, forming a connected acyclic graph (a tree).
constraints.formal: G = (V, E), |V| = n, |E| = n-1, G is a tree

constraints.name: start_node_fixed
constraints.description: Vlad always starts the game in room 1.

constraints.name: goal_leaf_excluding_start
constraints.description: Vlad wins by reaching a room other than 1 that has exactly one incident corridor (a leaf).
constraints.formal: ∀ v ∈ V, if v ≠ 1 ∧ deg(v) = 1, then v is a winning room for Vlad

constraints.name: friends_distinct_positions
constraints.description: All friends are placed in distinct rooms; no two friends occupy the same room.

constraints.name: friends_not_at_start
constraints.description: No friend starts in room 1; all friend rooms satisfy x_i ≥ 2.

constraints.name: simultaneous_moves
constraints.description: In each unit of time, every participant may traverse at most one corridor, and all moves happen at the same time.
constraints.formal: At each time step, each player chooses an adjacent node or stays; all choices are executed simultaneously

constraints.name: movement_optional
constraints.description: Participants are allowed to stay in their current room and not move during a time unit.
constraints.formal: ∀ player p, ∀ time t, p may choose to stay in place

constraints.name: room_capacity_unlimited
constraints.description: Any room can hold all participants at the same time without restriction.

constraints.name: catch_on_encounter
constraints.description: Friends win if a friend meets Vlad in any room or on any corridor before Vlad reaches a winning leaf.
constraints.formal: Friends win if ∃ f, t such that pos_t(f) = pos_t(Vlad) or they traverse the same edge in opposite directions between time t and t+1, and this occurs before Vlad reaches a leaf v ≠ 1 with deg(v)=1
